basic_details.job_title: JNGEC Graduate Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Jawaharlal Nehru Government Engineering College (JNGEC), Sundernagar, Himachal Pradesh, has 2 seats for Graduate Apprentice Trainees in Civil Engineering under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS), with a monthly stipend of Rs. 12,300/- for one year of training. Candidates must register on the NATS portal and then send their resume by email to [email protected] up to 10/11/2026, 11:59 PM, or submit a hard copy of the application form on or before 5:00 PM on 10 November 2026.

important_dates.interview_date: To be intimated to eligible candidates

qualification.details: Candidates must hold a B.Tech./B.E. in Civil Engineering from a recognized Institute/University. The essential qualification must have been attained during the years 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026, not before. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Civil Engineering seats.

salary_details.details: Each Graduate Apprentice Trainee in Civil Engineering will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 12,300/-. The apprenticeship training lasts one year, which is non-extendable, and takes place at Jawaharlal Nehru Government Engineering College, Sundernagar (H.P.). The notice does not mention any allowance in addition to the stipend.

selection_process: Selection is through an interview. The interview date will be intimated to eligible candidates
and only eligible and NATS-registered candidates who have applied will receive an interview call.
how_to_apply: Enrol on the NATS portal, https://www.jngec.ac.in, or the apprenticeship portal, https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in.
Provide the required details and upload the necessary documents to obtain a user ID and password.
Send your application with your updated resume and supporting documents by email to [email protected].
Make sure the email is sent up to 10/11/2026, 11:59 PM.

Alternatively, submit a hard copy of the duly completed application form in a sealed envelope addressed to the Director-cum-Principal, Jawaharlal Nehru Government Engineering College, Sundernagar, Himachal Pradesh, on or before 5:00 PM on 10 November 2026.
Duly completed application form (for the hard copy, in a sealed envelope)
NATS / apprenticeship portal registration (user ID and password)
important_instructions: The two deadlines differ by time: email applications are accepted up to 11:59 PM on 10/11/2026, while the hard copy must be submitted by 5:00 PM on 10 November 2026. For any queries, candidates may contact 01907-267199.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold a B.Tech./B.E. in Civil Engineering from a recognized Institute/University. The essential qualification must have been attained during the years 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026, not before. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Civil Engineering seats. Candidates who have previously undergone apprenticeship training in any establishment. Candidates who have been employed in any organization. Candidates who attained the essential qualification before 2022. Preference will be given to Himachal Bonafide candidates. Candidates must enrol on the NATS portal ( https://www.jngec.ac.in ) or the apprenticeship portal ( https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in ). Only eligible and NATS-registered candidates who have applied will receive an interview call.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: Each Graduate Apprentice Trainee in Civil Engineering will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 12,300/-. The apprenticeship training lasts one year, which is non-extendable, and takes place at Jawaharlal Nehru Government Engineering College, Sundernagar (H.P.). The notice does not mention any allowance in addition to the stipend.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JNGEC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Enrol on the NATS portal, https://www.jngec.ac.in , or the apprenticeship portal, https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in . Provide the required details and upload the necessary documents to obtain a user ID and password. Send your application with your updated resume and supporting documents by email to [email protected] . Make sure the email is sent up to 10/11/2026, 11:59 PM. Alternatively, submit a hard copy of the duly completed application form in a sealed envelope addressed to the Director-cum-Principal, Jawaharlal Nehru Government Engineering College, Sundernagar, Himachal Pradesh, on or before 5:00 PM on 10 November 2026. faq.question: Q1. How many seats are there in JNGEC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 seats for Graduate Apprentice Trainees in Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the JNGEC Graduate Apprentice seats?
faq.answer: Email applications are accepted up to 10/11/2026, 11:59 PM, and the hard copy must be submitted on or before 5:00 PM on 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: A B.Tech./B.E. in Civil Engineering from a recognized Institute/University, attained during the years 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026, not before.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend for JNGEC Graduate Apprentice Trainees?
Q5. How do I apply for the JNGEC apprenticeship?
faq.answer: Register on the NATS portal or apprenticeship portal, then email your application with an updated resume and supporting documents to [email protected], or send a hard copy in a sealed envelope to the Director-cum-Principal, JNGEC, Sundernagar.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by interview; the date will be intimated to eligible candidates, and only eligible and NATS-registered applicants will receive an interview call.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the training, and can it be extended?
faq.answer: The apprenticeship training lasts one year and is non-extendable.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates with earlier apprenticeship or job experience apply?
faq.answer: No. Candidates must not have previously undergone apprenticeship training in any establishment or been employed in any organization.

faq.question: Q9. Do Himachal Pradesh candidates get any preference?
faq.answer: Yes. Preference will be given to Himachal Bonafide candidates.
